transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because… there’s been an issue at work. For a few months I’ve noticed a pattern in the project files—small changes in the translation memory and timestamps. It involves some subcontractors and one colleague.

They’re making it look like my quality control failed. IT says the audit trail is clean, but… I don’t think that means much. The record’s been arranged so the blame lands on me.
Do you feel that others are plotting against you or acting with intentions to harm or deceive you, even if there’s no clear evidence?

Yes… in this case, yes. I don’t usually say it that way, but I think some subcontractors and one colleague have been changing little things in the project files—translation memory, timestamps—so it reflects badly on my quality control.

IT says there’s nothing in the audit trail, but I don’t trust that. It feels arranged so the blame ends up on me.
Have you noticed any changes in your senses—like hearing things that aren't there, seeing things others don't see, or feeling sensations with no clear cause?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed anything like hearing or seeing things that other people don’t. Nothing like that.
Outside of this situation at work, have you ever felt that people were plotting against you or trying to harm or deceive you without clear evidence?
No… not really outside of work. It’s mainly this situation with the project files. The subcontractors and that colleague—those changes to the translation memory and timestamps. That’s where I see it.
Have you ever had thoughts or beliefs that others have not shared, where you were certain of something that turned out not to be true, even though others tried to convince you otherwise?

I suppose… yes, this work situation. I know others don’t see it the way I do.

For months I’ve seen the same pattern in the project files—small changes in the translation memory and timestamps. Certain subcontractors, and one colleague, keep… adjusting things so it looks like my quality control failed. IT says the audit trail is clean, but I don’t accept that. It feels too arranged, like the record has been set up so the blame lands on me.

Despite IT saying the audit trail is clean and there’s no evidence supporting your concern, do you still feel certain that the subcontractors and your colleague are deliberately altering the files to frame you?

Yes. I know IT says it’s clean, but… I don’t believe that tells the whole story. The pattern’s been there for months—small changes to the translation memory, the timestamps lining up in ways that make my quality control look bad. It feels arranged. Like the record is being made to put the blame on me.

latest_inference.note: The patient continues to demonstrate a fixed, false belief (delusion) specifically centered around being framed at work, despite lack of evidence and contradictory reassurances from IT. There are no indications of prominent hallucinations or broader functional decline suggestive of other psychotic disorders like schizophrenia (F20.0) or acute psychotic disorder (F23.0). No features of mood episodes, making mood-congruent psychotic disorders less likely. Delusional disorder (F22.0) remains the most accurate diagnosis at this point.
